blocks.text: Lip Tint for Soft Color, Better Definition, and a Natural Finish

Lip tint adds soft, natural-looking color to your lips while improving definition and balance. At Pomi B. Brow Studio in Tustin, your lip color is customized to fit your skin tone, natural lip color, and everyday style.
Soft color and natural definition for everyday lips.
Lip tint is ideal if you want soft color without daily lipstick
Lip tint is a strong choice if your lips look pale, uneven, undefined, or washed out without makeup.
This service works well for clients who want a natural-looking tint, better lip definition, and a fresh everyday color that does not rely on constant lipstick or liner.
Add a natural tint that helps your lips look fresh and balanced.

The goal is not to create a heavy lipstick look. The goal is to enhance your natural lips with a shade that looks fresh, soft, and wearable every day.

Lip tint is a permanent makeup service that adds soft pigment to the lips for natural-looking color, better definition, and a more even tone.
Yes. Lip tint can be customized for a soft, natural-looking finish. The goal is to enhance your lips, not create a heavy lipstick look.
Who is lip tint best for?
Lip tint is a strong fit if your lips look pale, uneven, undefined, or if you want soft everyday color without applying lipstick or liner every day.
How long does lip tint last?
Results vary by skin type, lifestyle, aftercare, natural lip color, and how your skin holds pigment. Most clients need a touch-up to refine color and softness after the initial appointment.
The current price for Lip Tint + Touch Up is $600 + $100. Confirm current pricing when booking, since rates are subject to change.
Where is Pomi B. Brow Studio located?
The studio is located at 2801 El Camino Real, Ste 13 in Tustin, CA, near Irvine and central Orange County.
Who should ask before booking lip tint?
Ask before booking if you are pregnant, nursing, taking blood thinners, prone to keloids, have active cold sores, have a history of frequent cold sores, or have irritation near the lips.
Ready for soft, natural-looking lip color?
Book your Lip Tint appointment at Pomi B. Brow Studio in Tustin and get lip color designed for your face, your routine, and your style.
